technique_name: Describe the impact of global warming on the environment.
description: Global warming has had a significant impact on the environment. The Earth’s average temperature has risen substantially, resulting in increased sea levels, extreme weather events, and greater threats to biodiversity. Additionally, climate change has caused acidification of the oceans, changes in soil structure, and a decrease in crop yields. These effects are likely to worsen in the future as temperatures continue to increase due to the accumulation of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere. Further
